item.title: U.S. Forces Complete Mission in Syria to Transfer ISIS Detainees to Iraq
item.description: TAMPA, Fla. – U.S. Central Command (CENTCOM) completed a transfer mission following a nighttime flight from northeastern Syria to Iraq on Feb. 12 to help ensure ISIS detainees remain secure in detention facilities.

item.title: From Antarctica to the Bighorns, Wyoming Guard stories draw standing ovations at Capitol
item.description: CHEYENNE, Wyo. — The Wyoming House and Senate chambers are built for debate. On Military Recognition Day, they were built for something else. Applause rolled through both chambers this week after Maj. Gen. Greg Porter, Wyoming’s adjutant general, shared stories of Soldiers and Airmen whose missions stretched from the ice fields of Antarctica to artillery positions in Syria and a nighttime helicopter rescue in the Bighorn Mountains.

item.title: 7th MSC Soldier Completes Canadian Command and Staff College Training
item.description: Capt. Norman, assigned to the 7th Mission Support Command, part of the 83rd Combat Sustainment Support Battalion (CSSB), recently completed the Primary Reserve Army Operations College at the Canadian Army Command and Staff College, enhancing interoperability with allied forces.

item.title: Tulsa District reschedules start of State Highway 151 lane restriction
item.description: A lane restriction on State Highway 151 over Keystone Dam in Sand Springs, Okla., has been rescheduled to Feb. 23. Traffic over on SH-151 over Keystone Dam will be reduced to one lane Feb. 23. The lane restriction will last between two and three weeks to allow soil and rock core sampling.

item.title: NORAD INTERCEPTS AIRCRAFT VIOLATING TEMPORARY FLIGHT RESTRICTIONS OVER FT. BRAGG, NORTH CAROLINA
item.description: North American Aerospace Defense Command F-16 fighter aircraft intercepted a civilian aircraft Friday afternoon after it violated temporary flight restriction airspace over Fort Bragg, North Carolina.

item.title: MSC Hosts Industry Day in South Korea
item.description: Military Sealift Command (MSC) Far East hosted an Industry Day in Busan, South Korea, Feb. 10, to engage with regional industry partners and strengthen ship repair capabilities for MSC vessels operating throughout the Indo-Pacific.

item.title: ALS Graduation Takes the Field at Nationals Park for the First Time
item.description: The CMSAF Donald L. Harlow Airman Leadership School held a graduation ceremony at Nationals Park, Washington, D.C., February 12, 2026. The schoolhouse recognized 39 graduates for their accomplishments during the five-week course during a ceremony hosted by the Washington Nationals. Airman Leadership School, or ALS, is the first level of professional military education for enlisted members in both the U.S. Air Force and U.S. Space Force.

item.title: Keel Certified For MSC’s Newest Fleet Replenishment Oiler USNS Ruth Bader Ginsburg
item.description: Employees of Military Sealift Command Pacific (MSCPAC) and General Dynamics NASSCO of San Diego celebrated the keel certification of MSC’s newest ship, fleet replenishment oiler USNS Ruth Bader Ginsburg (T-AO 212) at the NASSCO shipyard San Diego today.

item.title: Training for the Unthinkable: Task Force 2 Validates Domestic Response Readiness
item.description: U.S. Army Soldiers assigned to Task Force 2 validated their readiness at Fort Bragg, Feb. 10–12, as part of the Defense CBRNE Response Force mission under U.S. Northern Command. The exercise integrated chemical, engineer, medical and military police units to rehearse hazardous materials reconnaissance, urban search and rescue, and mass decontamination during a simulated large-scale domestic incident. item.title: 'We're The Best In The World!’' – Washington National Guard supports Seahawks Super Bowl celebration
item.description: A sea of blue and green filled Fourth Avenue in Seattle on Wednesday, Feb. 11, 2026, as nearly a million fans celebrated the Super Bowl LX champion Seattle Seahawks and the franchise’s second title. As in 2014, the Washington National Guard played an integral role in the historic victory parade. While fans celebrated on a sunny Wednesday morning, the real work to get the parade set up happened in the days leading up to the event.
